facts.fact: Tigglestide Eve 清晨，Jessica 醒来时带着新的目标：不再干等 Greg 回来，而是主动出门去找他。
facts.anchor: On the morning of Tigglestide Eve, Jessica awoke with a new sense of purpose. No longer was she content to wait patiently for Greg to return.

facts.fact: 连日来 Molly 头一回没在厨房做早餐，她的缺席让 Jessica 胃底泛起一阵病态的下坠感。
facts.anchor: It was the first time in days that she didn’t find Molly already cooking breakfast, and Molly’s absence gave her a sick, sinking feeling in the pit of her stomach.

facts.fact: Jessica 认定市长就是个不折不扣的 Ebenezer Scrooge，既然等不来三只鬼点醒他，她决定亲自动手。
facts.anchor: She thought that the lord mayor was being a right proper Ebenezer Scrooge, and if she couldn’t count on three ghosts showing up to explain the error of his ways, then she would have to take matters into her own hands.

facts.fact: 集市人群里满是盛装：戴礼帽的狐狸、穿马甲的兔子、小丑与丑角，Jessica 以为都出自英国民间故事。
facts.anchor: There were foxes in top hats and rabbits in waistcoats, clowns and harlequins, and other costumes that Jessica did not recognize but that she assumed represented popular characters from British folklore.

facts.fact: 人群一阵涌动挡住视线，退去后那对扮成 Princess Kayla 与 Dargonna 的装扮者已经不见。
facts.anchor: But then the crowd surged momentarily, blocking her view of the couple. When it receded, they were gone.

facts.fact: Jessica 大衣底下只穿 negligee，计划到 Greg 工作处把他拉到一边、敞开大衣给他一个惊喜。
facts.anchor: Beneath her coat, she wore just her negligee. When she arrived at Greg’s work, she would get him alone and then she would open her coat to surprise him.

facts.fact: 这个生物整个罩在拖地白床单下，只有约十英尺高的头露在外面。
facts.anchor: It was draped entirely beneath a trailing white sheet, so that only the head, a good ten feet above the floor, was visible.

facts.fact: Round Robin 的头别扭地前倾、下颚脱开，向孩子们呕出如注的糖果，孩子们叫得更响、争抢赏赐。
facts.anchor: Round Robin’s head bowed forward awkwardly, its jaw unhinged, and it vomited a deluge of candy upon the children, who shrieked even louder as they scrambled for their reward.
